close_reason: Added Link.cid: Option<String> and Link.title: Option<String> (RFC 8984 §1.4.11); added 4 tests (cid_roundtrip, cid_absent, title_roundtrip, title_absent); 54 tests pass; clippy clean
description: RFC 8984 §1.4.11 defines two optional Link fields missing from the crate: (1) cid: Option<String> — a content-id for use in text/html descriptions that embed inline images via cid: URLs; (2) title: Option<String> — a human-readable, plain-text description of the linked resource. Both are #[serde(skip_serializing_if = Option::is_none)]. Without them, round-tripping Link objects that include these fields silently drops the data. Add both fields and tests for each.
title: Add Link.cid and Link.title fields (RFC 8984 §1.4.11)
